method: Chrome (headless, frame rate limit and vsync off, device pixel ratio 2, viewport 1280x1400, cross-origin isolated pages), a fresh page per block; esbuild production build; real pointer moves through the DevTools Protocol, each checked for its effect; latency runs from the move's first pointermove to a MessageChannel message posted from the requestAnimationFrame after its effect was drawn (null when not drawn within 1 s); work is the main-thread TaskDuration between a reading before each move is armed and one after its latency resolved (the move's work and the harness's evaluations), in a separate pass; sustained mode sends each move once the last was drawn, quiet mode waits 70 ms before each; with a baseline, blocks alternate AB/BA and comparisons are medians of the ratios of paired blocks' medians
